Night tips for customers
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Travelers using the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways need to check their pet travel papers and carrier setup before they come to the counter.

Plain steps save trouble for everyone. Bring your pet's booking details, keep your animal calm and secured, and let us know at once if anything looks wrong with the crate, the tag, or the approval note. We move fast on routine checks, but we do not rush safety.

If a traveler is worried, the desk will listen and review the case in a calm stepwise way before any further action is taken. If the matter needs more attention, it goes up through the proper channel without delay. This helps us protect the traveler, the animal, and the rest of the flight path.

Please stay close to the desk area, keep your phone ready, and follow the instructions given by staff. If you are moving through a busy skyport, allow extra space for your pet and avoid sudden changes that can unsettle the animal.

Please report to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before you board.
